FROZEN-CEMETERY WITH WITCH-FIRE — A cemetery entirely encased in black ice, every headstone locked inside its own glass prison; foreground: frost-moonflowers push up between ice-locked flagstones, their petals undamaged by cold that has frozen everything else; midground: an ornate iron cemetery-gate stands open, its hinges ice-fused in the open position; deep distance: a mausoleum at the cemetery's far end shows witch-fire green light bleeding from every door-crack and keyhole; sky: clear black absolute, stars brutal and overcrowded; owls perch on every ice-sheathed finial across the cemetery perimeter, motionless, eyes reflecting witch-fire green.

VOLCANIC CRATER-FIELD WITH WITCH-FIRE VENTS — A field of collapsed volcanic craters stretches to a skyline of dead black cinder-cones; foreground: bioluminescent fungi have colonised every crater-lip in dense orange-gold colonies, glow-thorn vines trailing down crater-walls; midground: witch-fire green flame vents from fissures between craters in rhythmic pulse-exhales, lighting the ash-ground from below; deep distance: a single intact tower of black basalt stands at the crater-field's far edge, its summit burning green continuously; sky: ash-cloud ceiling, lit orange and green from below by competing light-sources; bats stream from the standing tower in black ribbons.

CURSED-VILLAGE AERIAL — An entire village rendered in aerial perspective, its rooftop grid visible below a layer of unnaturally still fog that sits precisely at eave-height; foreground: the fog-surface is unbroken and flat, a suspended grey-white plane; midground: through fog-gaps, witch-fire green glows from multiple windows simultaneously — tavern, chapel, well-house — impossible lit geometry below the fog-lid; deep distance: a castle-glow on the hill above the village sends a column of candle-amber light down into the fog-plane; sky: overcast violet-black, the fog reflecting castle-light upward; crows wheel in grinding formations just above fog-level.

BLACKENED-CANOPY HAUNTED FOREST WITH BAT-RIBBONS — A forest of dead beeches whose canopy has fused into a single unbroken black ceiling, sealing out all sky-light; foreground: glow-thorn vines carpet the forest floor, pulsing cold blue-violet, the only light-source inside the canopy-seal; midground: bat-ribbons stream through the mid-storey from right to left in continuous flow, navigating the trunk-maze without deviation; deep distance: the canopy-ceiling develops a crack where a collapsed tree has opened a slot; through the slot, witch-fire green bleeds downward from a source above the canopy; sky: above the canopy-crack, a single line of violet cloud-drift visible.

DROWNED-TOMB-GARDEN CEMETERY — A formal cemetery-garden has flooded to ankle-depth, headstones rising from flat black still water; foreground: fireflies drift across the water-surface in slow dense constellations, their doubles perfect in the still water below; midground: a central mausoleum rises from the flood, its doors sealed shut with iron chains, yet candle-amber light seeps from the door-gap in trembling lines; deep distance: the cemetery-perimeter wall is entirely colonised by nightshade-and-belladonna in luminous bloom; sky: silver-cloud overcast, moonlight diffuse and total, casting no shadows; a murder of crows circles the central mausoleum in a grinding low orbit.

CASTLE-APPROACH MOUNTAIN-SPIRE — A dead road of cracked black stone leads across a basalt plateau toward a castle built directly onto a volcanic spire; foreground: luminous nightshade berries mark the road-edge in dual lines of cold amber-red luminescence, glow-thorn vines threading between them; midground: crows wheel at plateau-level in tight, grinding spirals, scale-provers against the spire-castle above them; deep distance: every window in the castle's clustered tower-mass burns witch-fire green simultaneously, the glow visible as a distinct atmospheric halo from the plateau-floor; sky: full storm-rack overhead, violet-black cloud-towers, the castle's witch-fire bleeding upward and staining the cloud-base acid-green.

BLACKTHORN WASTELAND MOOR — a raven-flock occupies every blackthorn crown across a heather-moorland rolling to a ruined abbey silhouette, the ravens absolutely motionless until a single one turns; foreground: nightshade-and-belladonna bloom-clusters purple and black through frost-bitten heather, black moss reclaiming every exposed stone; midground: the abbey ruin bleeds witch-fire green from lancet windows intact enough to hold glass; deep distance: moorland rises to fog-ceiling; sky: ash-grey with green cathedral-light staining the underbelly of low cloud.

SEA-CAVE COASTAL FJORD — a fjord of mirror-black water cuts between cliffs of fractured shale, bats streaming from a sea-cave mouth in black ribbons that unravel into the storm-air above; foreground: luminous nightshade berries and pale ghostly wildflowers cling to spray-wet ledges; midground: a drowned fishing village stands to its window-frames in black water, one window glowing witch-fire green from beneath the surface; deep distance: a storm-lighthouse pulses once every long minute; sky: pewter stormfront, purple at the horizon.

VOLCANIC ASH-PLAIN WITH FORGE-TOWER — a smoldering flatland of cracked obsidian plates ringed by dormant vents bleeding witch-fire green gas upward in slow columns; foreground: black moss reclaims the newest obsidian fractures, bioluminescent fungi growing on sulfur-crusted stone in acid-yellow rings; midground: an abandoned forge-tower still burns at its crown, a single forge-amber window visible three stories up; deep distance: ash-fall softens all silhouette; sky: charcoal ceiling lit from below by the forge-glow.

HAUNTED GOTHIC CANYON — a canyon of black-veined violet rock dropping hundreds of feet, glow-fungi carpeting every ledge in cold blue cascades visible from the canyon-rim; foreground: nightshade-and-belladonna cascade down crack-lines in the canyon wall, bioluminescent vines trailing into the dark below; midground: a cliff-perch monastery shows candle-amber in three lancet windows, luminous moss halo-ing its foundation stones; deep distance: canyon floor lost in purple-black; sky: a river of visible stars above the canyon-cut.

CATHEDRAL CLIFF-FACE RUIN — a cathedral built directly into a sheer cliff-face, its nave floors collapsed but its facade intact, witch-fire green bleeding from three immense lancet windows directly into open air above a gorge; foreground: black moss and glow-thorn vines consume the lower facade stones; midground: bats stream from the rose-window void above in continuous ribbon; deep distance: gorge below dissolves in violet mist; sky: the cliff-top lost in clouds, the cathedral facade framed in dark rock like a lit face.

MOUNTAIN-PASS CITADEL — a mountain pass between two sheer black-rock faces opens to a view of a distant citadel across a valley floor, its cluster of spires showing witch-fire green in upper windows and candle-amber in lower; foreground: glow-thorn vines bind the pass-walls, bioluminescent fungi tracing the stone-cracks in cold blue; midground: dead pines line the valley descent, wolves moving single-file between them visible at treeline; deep distance: citadel immense against the mountain-back; sky: deep blue-black, cloud wreathing the highest spires only.

SPECTRAL-WISP WOODLAND — a haunted forest of silver birch with bark peeling in black strips, spectral wisps drifting between trunks at knee-height in slow independent paths that suggest intention; foreground: moonflowers and ghostly pale wildflowers carpet the forest floor, bioluminescent fungi ringing the oldest root-crowns; midground: tree-density increases to near-impenetrability with witch-fire visible deep within as sourceless green; deep distance: forest closes; sky glimpsed only in fragments through bare canopy, deep violet.

TIDAL GRAVE-COAST — a coastal cemetery extending onto a tidal flat, headstones submerged to varying depths at high water, crows walking among the exposed grave-tops at low tide in absolute silence; foreground: sea-glass-pale moonflowers and luminous nightshade berries at the tide-line, black moss colonizing every stone above and below waterline; midground: a coastal mausoleum shows one candle-amber window at the water's edge, its reflection trembling; deep distance: storm-sea horizon; sky: pre-storm purple, lightning deep in distant cloud without sound.

HEATHER-FEN WILL-O-WISP MOOR — a cursed fenland where will-o-wisps outnumber stars, drifting in loose herds across black heather and peat-water channels, their cold white light casting moving shadows; foreground: bioluminescent fungi dot peat-hummocks, nightshade-and-belladonna bloom-clusters waist-height in lavender and black; midground: a roofless gatehouse at the fen's center shows lit windows glowing amber-candle impossibly; deep distance: fen opens to flooded plain dissolving in silver fog; sky: heavy cloud with wisp-glow reflected silver from above.

ICE-RIMED CASTLE MOUNTAIN — a castle growing directly from a vertical ice-rimed mountain face, its stones fused with glacial ice, one tower-window burning candle-amber like an ember in the white-blue mass; foreground: frost-crystallized glow-thorn vines on the approach-rocks, pale ghostly wildflowers in sheltered rock-splits; midground: ravens line every horizontal ice-shelf, hundreds, watching; deep distance: mountain range behind disappears into white; sky: arctic blue-black, stars brutally clear, aurora faint at the highest edge.

ASH-FALL RUINED CITY — a dead city under continuous fine ash-fall, every surface coated in grey-white, bioluminescent fungi in cold blue breaking through the ash on every rooftop and ledge visible from above; foreground: black moss consuming the ash-coated paving stones, nightshade pushing through ash-cracks; midground: one tower in the city-heart still burns at its crown, forge-amber against the ash-grey; deep distance: city-extent lost in ash-fog; sky: flat ash-white, the burning tower-crown the only warm color visible.

GARGOYLE CEMETERY — a monastic cemetery whose every major tomb is surmounted by a carved gargoyle, owls occupying the gargoyle-crowns in pairs, perfectly still and watching; foreground: glow-thorn vines web between tomb-bases, moonflowers silver-blooming in every soil-gap; midground: the monastery behind shows witch-fire green in its bell-tower lancets, shadows pooling at the base of each gargoyle column where no shadow should fall; deep distance: cemetery hillside drops to forest; sky: violet with slow-moving cloud.

BLACK-SEA LIGHTHOUSE COAST — a storm-coast of wave-shattered black rock where a lighthouse still burns though its keeper-house is collapsed, the light cycling amber across churning violet-black sea; foreground: pale ghostly wildflowers in rock-crevices, bioluminescent sea-foam catching in pools; midground: bats streaming from the collapsed keeper-house in black ribbons, dissolving into the storm-air; deep distance: the sea-horizon broken only by a sunken church-spire at low tide; sky: full storm, purple-grey, the lighthouse beam the only warm light.

NIGHTSHADE VALLEY CASTLE-APPROACH — a valley floor carpeted end-to-end in nightshade-and-belladonna bloom-clusters glowing violet-luminous in moonlight, the castle at the valley-head showing witch-fire green in its upper casements and candle-amber in its gate-towers; foreground: luminous berries and moonflowers in dense carpet, glow-thorn vines climbing the valley's flanking trees; midground: crows in the treeline, the entire left treeline watching; deep distance: castle immense, fog moving uphill from the valley floor against the wind; sky: deep blue-violet, cloud-fleet at speed overhead.

PETRIFIED CROW-WOOD — Haunted forest where ten-thousand crows wheel in slow gyroscopic formations above a canopy of calcified oak crowns bleached bone-white; foreground: glow-thorn vines lacing between exposed roots, bioluminescent fungi pulsing violet-amber in collapsed bark hollows; midground: a shattered bell-tower leaning into the canopy, its stones furred with black moss radiating cold silver light; deep distance: the forest dissolves into purple-grey murk where the treeline thickens impossibly; sky: bruised indigo with crow-silhouettes stitching dark calligraphy across a low gibbous moon.

ABBEY-RUIN WITH WITCH-FIRE GLASS — Cathedral ruin where stained-glass windows glow fel-green from within despite every roof collapsed and every nave open to storm; foreground: ghostly pale wildflowers carpeting the flagstone floor, moonflowers opening in silver rings around fallen column bases; midground: the cathedral's hollow ribcage of Gothic arches frames a choir of bioluminescent fungi colonizing the altar-plinth; deep distance: the bell-tower leans against a mountain-face swallowed by violet mist; sky: bats stream from the remaining belfry arch in dense black ribbons against cloud-marbled moonlight.

STORM-COAST OSSUARY CLIFFS — Coastal cliff biome where black-chalk headlands plunge hundreds of feet into thrashing iron-grey surf below, an abandoned lighthouse candle-amber glow burning in its sealed lantern-room; foreground: salt-scoured rock colonized by black moss and moonflowers trembling in sea-spray; midground: a half-collapsed sea-chapel clings to the cliff-face, its single window glowing impossibly amber; deep distance: a second headland dissolves into storm-haze, hinting at submerged ruins beneath churning surf; sky: purple-black storm-wall advancing, lightning threading its interior silver.

BLACKTHORN HEATH — Moorland biome where a treeless waste of blackthorn and dead heather stretches to a collapsed abbey ruin on the ridge-horizon, witch-fire green glowing in its window-gaps; foreground: luminous nightshade berries cluster along the path-edge, black moss webbing every stone in silver-green bioluminescence; midground: three wolves sit motionless on a tor-outcrop, watching; deep distance: the abbey ruin on the ridge bleeds green light into low cloud; sky: a bone-white moon hangs enormous in purple-black sky, shadows pooling across the heath where no object stands to cast them.

VOLCANIC WASTELAND FORGE — Volcanic wasteland biome where an abandoned forge-complex smolders on a black-obsidian plain, one furnace-tower burning witch-fire green despite no visible fuel or mechanism; foreground: black moss colonizing cooled lava-flows, bioluminescent fungi erupting from fissure-edges in amber-violet pulses; midground: collapsed forge-arches frame the burning tower, bats streaming from cracks in the masonry in agitated spirals; deep distance: the plain continues to a crater-rim silhouette, green witch-fire vents dotting the darkness; sky: ash-cloud purple-black, lit from below by the forge-glow in sickly amber.

MAUSOLEUM CITY NIGHTWATCH — Cemetery biome scaled to city-proportions, a vast necropolis of ornate mausolea rising four and five stories, every roofline occupied by stone gargoyles with owls perched between them; foreground: nightshade-and-belladonna bloom-clusters forcing through marble cracks, bioluminescent fungi pulsing in crypt-corner darkness; midground: a central tomb-cathedral, its windows sealed, yet witch-fire green bleeds from every seam and keyhole; deep distance: the necropolis continues beyond sight into violet murk; sky: low moonlit overcast, shadows pooling at every tomb-base in configurations no object present could cast.

PETRIFIED SWAMP-CATHEDRAL — Wetland biome where a Baroque cathedral has sunk to its transept in black swamp-water, buttresses hosting spectral wisps that drift between them with purpose; foreground: moonflowers blooming in silver rings on the water-surface, glow-thorn vines descending the drowned facade; midground: the cathedral's rose-window frame is intact, glowing moonlit violet from within as though candles burn inside the sealed nave; deep distance: the swamp opens into mist-obscured distance where dead-tree silhouettes multiply; sky: moon directly overhead, owl silhouetted on the highest surviving spire-tip.

CLIFF-COAST DROWNING VILLAGE — Coastal biome where a village of salt-grey stone buildings teeters at the edge of an eroding cliff above a vertical drop to black reef-churned water; foreground: black moss furred over every exposed surface, ghostly pale wildflowers at the cliff-edge in impossible defiance of salt-wind; midground: a drowned-half tavern window glows candle-amber from a building whose ground-floor has already collapsed into the sea; deep distance: storm-black water and sky merge, a single bioluminescent sea-cave glow visible at the cliff-base; sky: purple-charcoal storm, crows riding the updrafts in ragged formations.

HEATHER-MOOR SPECTRAL FEN — Moorland biome where purple-black heather rolls to a distant fen-basin, spectral wisps rising from the wet ground in lazy spiraling columns; foreground: luminous nightshade berries and moonflowers opening against black peat, black moss webbing every stone-wall remnant; midground: a roofless manor-shell on a low rise, its window-frames glowing impossibly amber despite total structural collapse; deep distance: the fen-basin reflects witch-fire wisps, doubling their light in still dark water; sky: cloud-marbled pewter, wolves visible as silhouettes on the far moor-ridge, motionless and watching.

OBSIDIAN GORGE MONASTERY — Canyon biome where a monastery complex is built directly into sheer obsidian cliff-faces, its windows glowing candle-amber and witch-fire green in staggered vertical tiers hundreds of feet above the gorge-floor; foreground: bioluminescent fungi and glow-thorn vines colonizing the gorge-floor rockfall, luminous nightshade berries threading through rubble; midground: a collapsed rope-bridge sags into the abyss between cliff-faces, moths circling its broken lanterns in dense pale spirals; deep distance: the gorge narrows to darkness with witch-fire vents still visible far below; sky: indigo-black slot overhead, fog moving sideways against the gorge-wind with slow impossible intention.
